text:
Marisol: Quick check — the new price sheet for cohort B is staged. CSV sent to vendors. Can folks confirm grandfathering flags look right?
Alex: Saw the sheet, row 42 seems off — multiplier is 1.05 but should be 1.0 for trial cohort.
Priya: Thanks Alex. I'll patch. Do we have guidance on prorated invoices for mid-cycle moves? :thinking_face: 
Kevin: Vendor said they can't accept a negative adjustment via API, only credit notes. We should map to 0 instead of negative line items.
Marisol: OK note — prefer credit notes. @Priya can you add that to the ops runbook?
Priya: Yep. Adding to runbook now. Also including SQL to find affected accounts:
Priya: ```sql
SELECT acct_id, old_rate, new_rate, effective_date FROM prices WHERE cohort IN ('B') AND effective_date > '2026-03-01';
```
billing-bot: Invoice task created: INV-2135 for cohort B adjustments. Assigned to Priya.
Alex: FYI A/B traffic split is 60/40 now. Can we gate cohort B rollout to 25% until billing sanity checks pass?
Marisol: Good call. Let's canary to 25% for 24h. Kevin, ping vendor to hold automated rate updates until we flip.
Kevin: Pinged vendor at 2135647922, they acked and will hold. They'll send back a sample invoice CSV by EOD.
Priya: When sample CSV arrives I'll run reconciliation script and post diffs. If >$100 discrepancy escalate to Marisol.
Marisol: Threshold noted. Also add grandfathering exceptions list — customers with active discounts >30% should be opted out automatically.
Alex: Do we have a mapping for discount tiers? If not, I'll export promo table.
Priya: I have it. Uploading to /shared/finance/pricing-experiments/cohortB/promos.csv now.
billing-bot: File uploaded to /shared/finance/pricing-experiments/cohortB/promos.csv
Marisol: Thanks. Action items: Priya run reconciliation on sample CSV, Alex export promos if needed, Kevin hold vendor updates, I'll approve canary once diffs OK. :thumbsup:
Kevin: On it.
Alex: Exported and added to the sheet. small note: rounding changed to 2 decimals vs previous 4 — confirm with accounting.
Priya: Accounting prefers 2 decimals. I'll normalize in the reconciliation script.
Marisol: Timeline — canary start 09:00 PST tomorrow for 24h. If no major billing diffs, escalate to 60% on day 2.
Alex: Sounds good. Any objections? No? :+1: 
Priya: No objections.
Kevin: No objections.
Marisol: Great — I'll post a summary to #announcements after canary flip.
